tasks.subject: Add local support for rate/irate over subquery ranges
tasks.description: Implement local planning/execution for rate(...) and irate(...) when their argument is a subquery expression (e.g. draft_cand_0225 and draft_cand_0242). Keep matrix-selector-with-subquery-step semantics working in query_range via local subquery + executeRangeVectorPlan. Add plan/analyzer/pruning updates to allow rate/irate subquery forms while keeping other rate-family subquery forms unsupported. Add unit tests for analyze, logical/execution planning, exec transforms, and service/API behavior; update hard integration assertions accordingly.
